worker_notes: Identity assessment: canonical text opens with “Revisiting the link between Mind Perception and Objectification: Replication and Extension of Gray et al (2011)”, authored by Tsz Ching (Ivard) Tsang and Gilad Feldman. It identifies itself as a preliminary MSc-thesis preprint, reports completed data collection and results, cites the exact Gray et al. original DOI 10.1037/a0025883, and links https://osf.io/w34fb and https://osf.io/8hdu3/ on main p. 17; supplementary p. 3 also links the supplied registration. Thus this is the primary replication report associated with that registration, rather than the registration itself. No PDF was supplied. Only n_r is assigned. The supplied Table 9 locator identifies the main full-sample analysis; its main-text Hypothesis 1 and Table 10 confirm the exact agency contrast. Analytic N = 673 is explicitly printed, independently consistent with 335 + 338 = 673 mutually exclusive between-subjects condition participants; this is not the whole-study N = 1009 and does not include Naked-condition participants. Supplementary post-exclusion variant is documented separately (321 + 315 = 636); not substituted for the main Table 9 analysis. The main model intentionally uses pre-exclusion data, as specified in supplementary p. 34.
